usedFor: Financial Cents holds bookkeeping clients and contacts, and Brevo lists them with “Add Contacts To List” after “New Client”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Financial Cents, then “Add Contacts To List” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: A new client lands on a Brevo list, so the right mailing starts without a manual import.

watchOut: “Add Contacts To List” works on contacts that already exist in Brevo, so a brand-new client may be missing.
